children.name: Eledone caparti Adam, 1950
children.description: Eledone caparti is a rare and little known species of benthic octopus from the Atlantic Ocean off the south-west coast of Africa.

children.name: Eledone cirrhosa
children.description: The curled octopus, also known as the horned octopus, lesser octopus or northern octopus, is a species of cephalopod found in the northeast Atlantic, ranging from Norway to the Mediterranean, including the British Isles. The total length of an adult is around 50 cm, but their arms are often tightly curled. It immobilises and eats large crustaceans by drilling a hole through their shell.

children.name: Eledone gaucha Haimovici, 1988
children.description: Eledone gaucha is a species of octopus from the southern Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Eledone massyae G.L.Voss, 1964
children.description: Eledone massyae, the combed octopus, is a small benthic octopus found off the Atlantic coasts of southern South America, particularly Argentina and southern Brazil.

children.name: Eledone moschata
children.description: Eledone moschata, the musky octopus, is a species of octopus belonging to the family Eledonidae.

children.name: Eledone palari Lu & Stranks, 1992
children.description: Eledone palari, commonly known as the spongetip octopus, is a species of benthic octopus from the coastal waters of the eastern Indian Ocean and the south-western Pacific.

children.name: Eledone schultzei
children.description: Eledone schultzei, the brush-tipped octopus, is a rare species of octopus. It has previously been known by other taxonomic names (synonyms) including Eledone thysanophora and Aphrodoctopus schultzei.
